subject.title: feat: retain iMessage tombstones and revisions

question: Should `sync` change from replacement-by-default to merge-by-default for existing archives, with users required to discover and use `--restore` for replacement?
rationale: This is a user-visible persistence and upgrade-policy choice, not a mechanical correctness decision: either default can be intentional, but existing archive semantics change materially.

options.title: Preserve replacement by default
options.body: Keep the existing replacement behavior as the default and add an explicit merge mode, avoiding a silent semantic change for current users.

options.title: Adopt merge by default
options.body: Accept retained absent rows as the new default only with explicit migration and upgrade documentation plus proof that existing archive workflows remain understandable.

recommendation.title: Preserve replacement by default
recommendation.body: Keep the existing replacement behavior as the default and add an explicit merge mode, avoiding a silent semantic change for current users.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review history ties this contributor directly to the proposed archive contract and its follow-up fixes.
